chapter: California, Art Tatum and Lionel Hampton
title: Lionel Hampton as genius and what Thompson learned from him
summary: Thompson calls Hampton the most talented drummer and vibist he played with, from whom he learned band playing, and describes his boyish spirit.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Right. One other thing I'd like to ask you about Hamp. Hamp's talents for improvisation and his knowledge of chord progressions and what not, I mean he's an extremely experienced musician, is he not?

Well, I always said, and I say this still now, I have never -- I've played with all the musicians that you can name, practically, that were jazz musicians in my life time, and I've never played with anyone more talented on the drums or the vibraphones than Lionel. And of course

he can play that piano with those two fingers, and get a lot of music out of it. And he's -- the man is incredible, he's just a natural born genius as a player, as a player. There's no doubt in my mind, as Dan -- and I would also have to say that I learned more from him than I had from anyone else as far as playing music is because before that I had been primarily an arranger.
And I hadn't concentrated on band playing with rhythm sections. I had been a good solo player of parties, but I had never been exposed to the real hardcore jazz, you see.

And this is where I really got that foundation. And Lionel -- as I said, the man is a genius, is just -- he gets so much out of what he does, it's unbelievable how that man can play the drums and the vibraphones, as I said. My personal opinion is there's no one can top him. He is a marvelous musician.
He's so integrated with his band, isn't he? I mean, he sets off his band in such a marvelous way, doesn't he?
Well, Lionel in so many ways is like a

little boy, which is very good. I think a person who can keep these feelings as a young person, have these young ideas and doesn't get too wrapped up in themselves, too serious, I think is an asset. And that's the thing that keeps Lionel young and agile. The man has the mind -- he keeps himself young in spirit. He's always enjoys what he's doing.
Completely. And that's one of his attributes.
Yes. The well springs are there. It isn't put on or it isn't a front.
